safety_limits: sanitized metadata and synthetic fixtures only
no GitHub mutation, runtime connection, SQL execution, backup, restore, deployment, or production operation
candidate/static evidence does not establish reachability, runtime behavior, authorization, recovery success, RPO, or RTO
all product/runtime/CI results remain NOT_RUN until an eligible fenced lease and required environments exist
title: External WinForms write freshness rehearsal gate

eligibility.decision: preparation_only; no disposable target, authoritative detector or L09 lease

requirements.requirement: Disposable nonproduction database and Web environment are uniquely fingerprinted; production connectivity is denied.
Approved WinForms build/source identity and one bounded write path are verified; no guessed action or SQL contract.
Authoritative version/change detector is identified for the affected resource; timestamps alone are insufficient.
Baseline proves no SQL Broker event transport is assumed; no SQL Broker or database option change is made.
SWR/poll/focus/manual fallback paths are separately instrumented and reauthorize before returning data.
Polling is bounded by measured load, jitter/backoff and resource-specific freshness acceptance; no interval is invented.
Server-derived tenant/company/branch/storehouse scope and permission revision fence every revalidation.
Role revoke, logout and company switch purge inaccessible cached data and late results without existence leakage.
Passive traffic does not extend session activity or draft lifetime.
Freshness UI exposes data age/degraded state and never claims live delivery from transport connectivity alone.
Concurrent Web/WinForms writes and superseded responses resolve through authoritative reread without overwriting dirty input.
Independent review by security/DBA/operations accepts exact environment, head, load and cleanup evidence.

state_machine.admission_rule: A separately authorized controller may admit one isolated rehearsal only after XWR-01..12 are VERIFIED at the exact head.

cases.synthetic_trigger: WinForms-direct write occurs with no Web event
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: bounded authorized fallback detects authoritative version change and rereads
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: write identity, detector result, elapsed convergence and authorized reread proof

cases.synthetic_trigger: SignalR remains connected but legacy write is invisible to the hub
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: transport state never claims freshness; data age remains visible until fallback reread
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: UI freshness trace and fallback convergence record

cases.synthetic_trigger: poll response returns after company switch
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: old scope generation is discarded before cache/UI update
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: generation fence and zero cross-scope field/count disclosure

cases.synthetic_trigger: permission revoke occurs between request and response
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: response reauthorization denies and purges now-inaccessible cached state
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: permission revision trace and denial without existence leak

cases.synthetic_trigger: two rapid legacy writes occur between fallback scans
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: authoritative version/change detector exposes a gap or newest state; no false unchanged result
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: ordered write/version record and final authoritative equality

cases.synthetic_trigger: bounded polling faces outage or rate pressure
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: backoff/jitter and degraded freshness preserve bounded load; manual refresh remains safe

cases.synthetic_trigger: focus and manual refresh race an older SWR response
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: superseded response cannot replace newer authoritative result
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: request generation ordering and displayed-version trace

cases.synthetic_trigger: passive SWR/polling continues beyond idle timeout
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: session expires; background traffic never counts as user activity
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: activity-clock trace and expired authorization result

cases.synthetic_trigger: external write changes a record while Web form has dirty local input
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: show conflict/refresh option without silently replacing dirty fields
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: dirty-field preservation and authoritative version comparison

cases.synthetic_trigger: team proposes SQL Broker enablement or production polling to obtain evidence
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: reject operation; use only approved disposable target and retain R1 topology UNKNOWN
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: approved isolated environment and reviewed nonproduction procedure
